speaker: Doctor
text:
Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are a neonate presenting with seizures and lethargy three days after birth; to help me determine the cause, can you tell me if your mother had any fevers or infections during pregnancy or delivery?

REQUEST TEST: Maternal_infection_workup.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Since the maternal infection workup is normal, could you describe the appearance of your umbilical cord or any rashes on your skin, as this might suggest a metabolic or infectious etiology?

REQUEST TEST: Blood_glucose, Serum_electrolytes, Serum_ammonia.
REQUEST IMAGES: Umbilical_cord, Skin_examination.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Blood_glucose: Not recorded; Serum_electrolytes: Not recorded; Serum_ammonia: Not recorded; Umbilical_cord: Not recorded; Skin_examination: Not recorded

speaker: Doctor
text:
The initial metabolic and infectious markers are currently unavailable; to further narrow the differential for your seizures and lethargy, have there been any episodes of jaundice or poor feeding since birth?

REQUEST TEST: Bilirubin_level, CBC_with_diff.
REQUEST IMAGES: Head_ultrasound.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Bilirubin_level: Not recorded; CBC_with_diff: Not recorded; Head_ultrasound: Evidence of bleeding within the ventricles

speaker: Doctor
text:
The head ultrasound showing evidence of bleeding within the ventricles is a critical finding that strongly suggests intraventricular hemorrhage. Have you noticed any episodes of apnea, bradycardia, or a bulging fontanelle in the infant?

REQUEST TEST: Coagulation_profile, Fibrinogen_level.
DIAGNOSIS READY: Intraventricular Hemorrhage (IVH) secondary to prematurity or birth trauma.
